integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. Numerical checks only corroborate random instances and the explicit equality family; they are not used as evidence for the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Sharp for a common orthogonal projector on finite-dimensional states. No claim is made for arbitrary effects, different branch maps, or multistage composition. A remote possibility remains that the commuting/classical conditioning inequality appears in older probability literature under different terminology.
title: Sharp trace-distance amplification under projective postselection
